name: allocait
description: Check a portfolio against its own written allocation rules, plan a rebalance, and keep positions, cash, and rules current, through the Allocait MCP connector. Allocait never places trades or gives investment advice; every check runs against rules the user declared themselves.

allocait_api_key.title: Allocait API key
allocait_api_key.description: Your Allocait agent API key, from Settings > Developer in the Allocait app. Sent only as the x-api-key header on calls to Allocait's own MCP server. This field is the interim way to connect in Claude Code, before Allocait's OAuth connector ships; see the README.
